Hi Marcus / Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — excited about the progress on commercial terms. As we narrow SLA points for latency and availability for the route-optimization batch workloads, the Legal/Procurement and Platform teams at FreightWave asked for a short set of customer references that can speak specifically to production latency SLOs and multi-tenant isolation.

Would you be able to introduce 1–2 internal advocates who could do a 30-minute reference call next week? Ideal advocates would be someone on Ops/Platform who owned the integration and someone on the product side who can speak to reliability under peak loads. If helpful, we use a short reference template (attached) and typically run a 20/10 split: 20 minutes technical + 10 minutes business/contract Qs.

Attachments: reference_request_template.pdf (short template we send advocates)

Proposed slots (PT): Wed 11/10 11:00–11:30, Thu 11/11 14:00–14:30, Fri 11/12 09:00–09:30. I can flex. Please let me know who you recommend and if Procurement needs an NDA in advance.

Appreciate the help — Jordan
